_about: RECORDED 2026-10-09 from the Prints panels AS THEY STOOD BEFORE Studio › Prints moved onto the ActionButton: `PrintSetDownloads` and `PassCardsPanel` rendered (lazy pieces settled) for six access states — what a customer READS (every word, in order), the Pro door's href and hook, the access line, the go-Pro pitch, the print-ready hooks. The Prints panels hold no price and no confirm step (the unlock page, `/dashboard/<id>/studio/website-pro`, owns both); what they carry about money is this wording and this one door, and it must not change by a byte. Re-record only with a reason written in the commit. RE-RECORDED 2026-10-16 — owner ruling, DECISION_LOG "PRINTS: ONE AT A TIME IS FREE — EVERY 'DOWNLOAD ALL' IS EVENT HUB PRO" (verbatim: "Whole set (PDF) and Every guest's pass (PDF) become Pro. Each piece's own PDF, and each guest's own pass one at a time, stay free."): the whole set, every guest's ticket and the Printed ticket batch now wear the zip's ◆ pattern — owned: the file, ◆ unlocked; a free couple: the SAME one door to the unlock page; the store shell: absent. Still no price and no confirm step. RE-RECORDED 2026-10-22 (twice) — owner: "the goal of the free is to keep everything minimum ready but no personalization." First (DECISION_LOG "FREE IS READY, PRO IS PERSONAL — ALL TICKETS AND THE QR SHEET ARE FREE"): every guest's ticket in one file lost its ◆ door. Then (owner "yes", DECISION_LOG "THE DIGITAL TICKET ZIP IS FREE"): the digital ticket zip became a plain free save on every state, store shell included — its PRO word and its door left; nothing else moved. Still no price and no confirm step.
